title: openai-chat: no system-after-tool (Mistral 400)
content: The bro-harness openai-chat transport (vibe/Mistral) must never place a `system` message after a `tool` message — Mistral returns 400 `invalid_request_message_order` ("Unexpected role 'system' after role 'tool'"). `build_body` (crates/bro-harness/src/transport/openai_chat.rs) folds the volatile system tail into the leading system block when the conversation ends in tool results; trailing-system placement is only safe after user/assistant turns (both verified accepted against the live Mistral API). Anthropic-transport providers (GLM/DeepSeek/MiniMax/Brodex) are immune — their system is a top-level param, not an inline message. Symptom when violated: a vibe agent that makes a tool call dies on the post-tool turn, surfacing as Interrupted/failed in the Fleet TUI, while plain-text turns succeed. Fixed in commit 68435ad.
